metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over how to get rid of a pinched nerve in lower back with ONE EASY MOVEMENT. 

In this video, extension exercises are going to be shown in different positions to help relieve pain from a pinched nerve in lower back.

These will be effective for a lumbar herniated disc and bulging disc, and symptoms such as sciatica pain (or sharp, shooting leg pain).  

Watch now and take one step towards better health!
